mount_points.description: Space-separated list of mount points that shall be monitored and managed.

mount_opt.description: Mount options for the tmpfs mounts.

ramfs_size.description: Size of the tmpfs mounts in Megabytes. 0 means 50% of RAM.

ramfs_limit.description: Maximum size of files in the tmpfs mounts in Megabytes. 0 means no limit.

conf_swapsize.description: Size of the swap file in Megabytes. 0 means no swap file is created/adjusted.

conf_maxswap.description: Maximum size of the swap file in Megabytes. 0 means no limit.
